title: exact large-moving-prime redundancy of the j=1 endpoint scalar
proved: For every h>=1, the phase-reflected Gosper antidifferences satisfy Rplus(j)=-Rminus(-2s_h-j+1).
For every h>=1, F_h-d_h=c_h*X_h and eta_h*U_h+L_h=c_h*Y_h with the explicit finite sums X_h,Y_h.
The Item280 endpoint scalar factors without endpoint division as K_h=c_h*(2*d_h*Y_h-L_h*X_h).
The factor 2*d_h*Y_h-L_h*X_h and K_h have denominators supported only on primes <=4h+3.
For h>=1 with 3 not dividing h, Item243's gauge c_h=G_h*E_h has G_h a unit after localizing at primes <=4h+3.
For every prime q>4h+3, q|N_E(h) implies q|N_K(h); no converse is claimed.
Every actual prime p=4h+6s+3 with s>=1 satisfies 3 not dividing h and p>=4h+9, so K_h is redundant after E_h on every actual row.
exact_replay_not_extrapolation: The deterministic checker replays the proved reflection, two endpoint identities, K factorization, gauge, and denominator support through h<=12.
open: Nonvanishing, sparsity, or weighted control of E_h modulo the actual moving row prime.
